notes.desc:
- fix: support current apksigner output and recover release initialization (48f4d3b3)
- fix: harden release pipeline and automatic updates (0e45b000)
- perf: 原生横滑保护启用时移除重复的 JS 翻页命令 (45bbb96c)
- fix: 修正横滑手势父容器的接口调用 (8a946afa)

- fix: 修复音源自动切换与初始化等待回收 (16a2655d)
- docs: refine README with professional product descriptions (4ed10122)
- docs: highlight LX Music X features and listening experience (d2bdc81e)
- fix: 修复预加载清理、降档缓存及脚本回收 (a4e80e6c)
- fix: probe audio headers and isolate source cooldown failures (406cb205)
- fix: reuse audio probe ranges and clarify playback diagnostics (a3d6adc4)
- feat(player): add playback and preload diagnostic logging (12e773d1)
- fix(player): synchronize playback and custom source switching (bb89d3bc)
- fix: recover stalled next-track preloading after failures (c14a3387)
- perf: reduce retained UI state and redundant playback work (740ca338)
- fix: align audio probing with playback and support source formats (3694829c)
- fix: validate QQ source audio before playback and preloading (44e8d7ba)
- fix: stabilize requests, playback state, downloads and session caching (6d8335d5)
- fix: preserve background preloading and temporary playback handoff (24de1335)
- docs: rewrite README with neutral user-facing documentation (5b88d6c0)
- feat: add download share and cache actions to player menu (5aed3d9e)
- fix: reject incomplete QQ account audio and cached previews (b139af10)
- fix: stabilize sizing across tablet window transitions (8f594b5d)
- Fix tablet split-screen layout and modal sizing (877f6502)
- Fix memory lifecycle and release idle UI resources (f81138a6)
- fix: 优化平板弹窗并保留播放页位置 (c5cb5687)
- fix: 调整平板当前播放列表尺寸 (8ba07c77)
- fix: 平板播放详情三页滑动同时展示两页 (4df6b80a)
- feat: 优化平板导航和播放布局 (9211beaf)
- fix: 修复下载内存回收、音质与搜索缓存 (d1219950)
- fix: 平板推荐歌单恢复横向滑动 (f2eef3cb)
- style: 平板导航的首页/我的改为上下相邻 (b639adad)
- fix: 平板导航只保留首页/我的，其余页面用竖屏结构 (643c94cf)
- fix: 修复平板导航返回与网格缩放 (b3347f81)
- feat: 平板横屏改左侧导航和多列布局 (82dd472a)
- style: 精简音源排序和预加载说明 (99cc8aa9)
- fix: 修正预加载音质与取消边界 (d4694f2d)
- feat: 增加下一首预加载和自定义音源优先级 (86560231)
- refactor: 移除竖屏首页横向滚动开关 (c479613a)
- fix: 优化歌词定位并取消过期滚动 (df96e1c6)
- chore: 开发约定仅保留在本地 (63f9938d)
- fix: 修复页面返回时背景闪烁 (4419bd73)
- perf: 降低内存占用并优化下载与搜索 (615494f9)
- chore: 清理未引用的导出和废弃工具函数 (778ea1e5)
- fix: 恢复 QQ 歌词翻译并升级旧缓存 (33c58424)
- fix: 修复 QQ 会话和歌单缓存并发写入 (5b427261)
- fix: 审查修复（收藏换号写保护/备份提示/迁移容错） (53ae4b7e)
- chore: 清理废弃功能并修复歌单缓存分页 (ce02a31b)
- fix: bound and cancel QQ playback probes and refresh stale checks (1ca906f4)
- fix: align QQ account playback fallback with MusicOne (364cc9a3)
